title: Patient Payment Plan Worksheet: The Pause Window by Assistance Case Status
content:
The pause window of a **Patient Payment Plan** assistance pause follows the status of the patient's open financial assistance case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care). A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. Its receipt date is that case's application date. The installments considered are those falling due after the receipt date and on or after the plan's next due date.

**Rule.** For a case in pending documents status whose documents due date is on or after the handling date, the window runs to the documents due date, so it also takes in the installments that will fall due by then, located as the whole months from the first due date to the documents due date plus one. For a case in submitted status, the installments in the window are counted by elapsed time instead of by due dates, one for each full 30 days from the receipt date to the handling date, but never more than the considered installments that have fallen due by the handling date, so an installment already paid is never paused. Otherwise the window ends on the handling date. Here whole months are counted the calendar way, a month complete only once the later date's day number reaches the earlier date's day number (from the 31st, a month without that day is not yet complete at its last day).

| Open case | Window | Installments in the window |
|---|---|---|
| pending documents, documents due date on or after the handling date | to the documents due date | considered installments falling due on or before the documents due date |
| pending documents, documents due date already passed | to the handling date | considered installments falling due on or before the handling date |
| submitted | elapsed time | one per full 30 days from the receipt date to the handling date, never more than the considered installments fallen due by the handling date |
| none open | to the handling date | none are considered |

**Hypothetical (submitted case).** Received 75 days before the handling date: 75 days hold 2 full periods of 30 days, so 2; if 3 considered installments have fallen due by the handling date, the window holds 2; if only 1 has, it holds 1.

**Hypothetical (pending documents).** Plan due on the 1st; next due date 1 May; receipt 10 April; handling date 20 May; documents due 15 July. The window runs to 15 July and takes in the installments of 1 May, 1 June and 1 July: 3.
